title: LookupError in settings.validate when reloading the settings
body:
Environment

Running Lattice 3.0.4 on Windows Server 2022 against eu-
central-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
- With the log window open, start reloading the settings.
- Use an old settings file with the retired name.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

Expected

Expected reloading the settings to finish without errors.

Actual

The lookup wants a name that is only in the settings file.
That name no longer exists in this release; the settings
file still uses the old one.

Frequency

Reproduces every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/cli.py:11 in main
lattice/core/app.py:35 in start
lattice/core/boot.py:103 in load_all
lattice/core/settings.py:277 in validate
LookupError: unknown encoding: 'utf8-sig'
